name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 40 – Am 63
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 40a. Underlines that freedom of expression, as protected by Article 11 of the Charter, includes the right to criticise migration policies, gender ideology and woke activism without that criticism being labelled as hate speech or disinformation;
